scope: Read-only Sonnet 5.5 review; no code/model runs by reviewer.

dispositions.1_reporter_bounds: Report signed reporter bounds and cap saturation; preserve finite original bounds rather than reject legitimate blocked/forced models. Add blocked and forced reporter tests. These are conditional model results, not biological negatives.
dispositions.2_endpoint_status: Add separate growth_status and product_status; overall completed if at least one endpoint informative. Preserve lethal growth contrast when product is unassessed. Add regression.
dispositions.3_growth_floor: Preserve existing per-genotype growth-fraction protocol. Expose each absolute product growth floor and document allocation confounding. No matched-growth causal claim.
dispositions.4_minimum_always_zero: Rejected: mass balance can force disposal of a biomass byproduct through a zero-lower-bound reporter. Add explicit coupled-byproduct regression; retain minimum LP.
dispositions.5_oracle_coverage: Enforce bidirectional phenotype key equality and independently classify demand cells from GLPK endpoints. Add tampered missing-interval and wrong-class tests.
dispositions.6_evidence_ranking: Existing evidence heuristic remains an ordering, not probability. Combining linked evidence does not always strictly outrank parents; products remain excluded from learned features. No planner benefit claimed.
dispositions.7_input_failure: Retain fail-fast physical validation in Python; builder cannot certify full SBML chemistry. Explicit invalid masked input is not a biological negative. Direct invalid Runner items are programming/input errors. Menu construction reports invalid target hints.
dispositions.8_circularity_guard: Extend historical planner benchmark guard to product_demand even under a non-BGC evidence type; add regression. No frozen benchmark outcomes changed.
dispositions.9_compartments: Document non-extracellular rather than cytosol-only. No automatic compartment/name remapping.
dispositions.preexisting_threshold: Exact growth threshold >= versus > predates this extension; not changed here.
